# Pull Request Template

## 🎯 Description
A clear and concise description of what this PR does.

## 📝 Related Issues
Fixes #(issue)
Relates to #(issue)

## 🔄 Type of Change
- [ ] ✨ New feature
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix
- [ ] 🔧 Refactoring
- [ ] 📚 Documentation
- [ ] ⚡ Performance
- [ ] 🔒 Security
- [ ] 🚨 Breaking change

## 🧪 Testing
Describe the tests you've added or updated:
- [ ] Unit tests added/updated
- [ ] Integration tests added/updated
- [ ] Manual testing completed

## 🔍 Checklist
- [ ] Code follows style guide (`npm run lint:fix`)
- [ ] Self-review completed
- [ ] Comments added for complex logic
- [ ] Documentation updated
- [ ] No new warnings generated
- [ ] Tests pass locally (`npm test`)
- [ ] No breaking changes (or documented)
- [ ] Database migrations tested (if applicable)

## 📸 Screenshots (if UI changes)
If applicable, add screenshots or GIFs

## 🎓 Learning & Rationale
Explain the architectural decisions and why you chose this approach:
- Why this solution over alternatives?
- Any tradeoffs or limitations?
- Potential edge cases handled?

## 🚀 Deployment Notes
Any special considerations for deployment:
- Database migrations needed?
- Environment variables changed?
- External service dependencies?
- Rollback plan?

## 📋 Reviewer Notes
Help reviewers focus on important areas:
- What should reviewers pay special attention to?
- Any known issues or TODOs?
